propositions: The dedup suite cannot prove end-to-end that disabling BindingStore.is_comment_mapped changes behavior because differ tests and apply tests each seed invariants independently without crossing the seam with a control that exercises the actual guard

A real envelope posted through _record_comment_id against a real BindingStore must be skipped on re-diff via _diff_comments against that same store instance, while an unrecorded control comment still emits
Forcing BindingStore.is_comment_mapped to False must cause a previously-recorded comment to re-emit on re-diff, proving the seam assertion discriminates on the guard rather than passing vacuously
The test drives the whole seam with a real BindingStore using the recorded ACLI envelope obtained through the real acli_cli_ops.add_comment stubbed only at the subprocess boundary
